blockers.description: Reopen evidence: Railway production, read 2026-10-05 via the Railway API: every service (api, ai-worker, events-worker, ingestion-worker, notifications-worker) has `OTEL_ENABLED=false` and no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `ws` has no OTel vars. `infra/terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars` keeps OTel off until `otel_exporter_endpoint` is set, and it is not set. Production exports no traces, metrics or logs.

Reopen evidence: KPI "100% services emit traces/metrics/logs; alerting configured; dashboards live" fails in production. `anomaly-detection.json` and `self-healing-rules.yaml` are config files that no running system loads.

To close: (1) Production emission on (IFC-032). Any anomaly or self-healing claim needs a running consumer, or must be re-scoped with the owner. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.

Re-plan 2026-10-16 (owner ruling "Fix the 15 tasks"): not Completed, no exemption. Target Sprint moved to 18 in Sprint_plan.csv so the strict sprint gates stay honest. Still open: ws, events-worker and ingestion-worker emit nothing (enabling them needs the OTLP header secret set on those Railway services, owner-only); no anomaly detection or self-healing rule is loaded in Grafana; no SLO is defined there. Verified 2026-10-16: Railway production api and ai-worker have OTEL_ENABLED=true and export to the Grafana Cloud gb-south-1 gateway; ws, events-worker and ingestion-worker do not (events-worker and ingestion-worker OTEL_ENABLED=false, ws has no OTel variables). Grafana holds span metrics for api and ai-worker and ai-worker pino log lines carrying trace_id/span_id; no api pino log line has reached Loki yet.

NEEDS_HUMAN (2026-10-25): production proof follows merge: grafana-alert-rules.yml green again; grafana-slos.yml and grafana-dashboard.yml push runs plus dry_run dispatches report the 3 SLO uuids and env008-production present; railway-self-healing.yml push run log shows before/after (and whether the live probe let the api health check through).
